title: Data Structures & Algorithms for Interviews
intro: DSA fundamentals (fresher level) covers the data structures and algorithms a junior interview expects. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with complexity analysis (Big-O — the language every following answer is written in), then the linear structures (arrays, strings, linked lists, stacks, queues). Hashing follows (the enabler of O(1) interview solutions), then sorting, binary search, and trees — the structures that close the fresher DSA canon.
